common.usernameHint: 3–50 characters: letters, digits, dot, hyphen, underscore, @

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.languageLoad: The language could not be loaded.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to access your documents.

setup.title: Set up AIDocuments
setup.subtitle: Start by creating the administrator account. You can add more users in the settings afterwards.
setup.codeHint: Shown in the server log at startup (Docker: docker compose logs).

features.import: PDFs from your mailbox and import folder
features.search: Full-text search right into the document

twoFactor.title: Confirm sign-in
twoFactor.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.codeHint: No access to the app? Enter one of your recovery codes instead.

twoFactorRequired.title: Set up two-factor authentication
twoFactorRequired.subtitle: Two-factor authentication is mandatory for administrators. Set it up now to continue.
twoFactorRequired.intro: You will need an authenticator app on your phone (e.g. Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password or Aegis).

search.placeholderAi: AI search: ask in your own words – e.g. “invoices from Kia from 2024”
search.label: Search documents

dropzone.title: Drop PDFs or photos here
dropzone.hint: You can drop several files at once. Photos (JPG, PNG, HEIC) and e-invoices (XML) become PDFs. Everything is saved, analyzed and tagged.

notifications.title: Email notifications
notifications.emailHint: Due reminders assigned to you and the notifications you turn on below are sent here – in the language you are currently using the app in. Leave empty if you do not want any emails.
notifications.digestHint: Once a day, a list of the documents that arrived in your areas – only on days with new documents.
notifications.adminHint: When retention periods end (nothing is deleted automatically) and when a mailbox repeatedly cannot be checked.
notifications.needsEmail: Without an address, no emails are sent.

upload.onlyPdf: Only PDFs, photos (JPG, PNG, HEIC) and e-invoices (XML) can be added.
upload.noneValid: None of the files could be added.

combine.title: Combine photos into one document?
combine.text: You selected several photos. If they are the pages of one document – a letter with several pages, say – they become one PDF in the order of their file names; you can change the order afterwards under “Pages”. Otherwise each photo becomes a document of its own.
combine.tooMuch: These are too many or too large photos for one document (at most 100 photos and 240 MB in total).

aiNotice.text: The AI has not been set up yet. New documents can be searched by their text, but they are not summarized or tagged.
aiNotice.builtinOcr: Scans without a text layer are read by the built-in text recognition, so they are searchable too.

progress.inProgressHint: Waiting for AI analysis or currently being analyzed
progress.finishHint: Expected to finish: {{time}} – estimated from the pace of the most recently processed documents

filters.title: Filters
filters.hint: Once documents have been analyzed, document types, tags and senders will appear here as filters.

empty.libraryHint: Simply drag PDFs or photos into this window or use “Upload”.
empty.libraryHintAdmin: Simply drag PDFs or photos into this window or use “Upload”. In the settings you can set up a mailbox or an import folder from which new documents are imported automatically.
empty.noResultsSearch: No document matches this search. The search also finds parts of words – try a shorter term or fewer words.
empty.noResultsFilters: No document matches the selected filters.

aiSearch.notice: AI search: “{{question}}”. The filters show how the question was understood.

export.label_other: Export all {{count, number}} documents of this list as ZIP
export.contents: The ZIP file contains the PDFs and all details as a table (documents.csv) and as documents.json.

mailboxNotice.text_one: The mailbox “{{names}}” has failed to be checked several times in a row – no documents are arriving from it.
mailboxNotice.text_other: These mailboxes have failed to be checked several times in a row: {{names}}. No documents are arriving from them.

backupNotice.never: There is no backup of your documents yet.
backupNotice.overdue: Last backup: {{when}}. That is longer ago than configured.

document.reprocessHint: Read the PDF again and have the AI analyze it
document.reprocessStarted: The document is being analyzed again.

pdf.saved: Changes saved – the original is kept.
pdf.modified: Changed on {{when}} – the original is kept.
pdf.restoreText: The changed version will be discarded. The document will then be exactly as it was when it arrived.

duplicate.notice: Possibly a duplicate: this document matches “{{title}}” in content.

document.processingNotice: The document is being processed. The summary and tags will appear here as soon as the analysis is finished.
document.textOnlyNotice: Indexed without AI: the document can be searched by its text, but it has no summary and no automatic tags.

tags.inputHint: Confirm with Enter or a comma. Suggestions are tags that are already in use.

document.noText: There is no text for this document – it is probably a scan without a text layer. With the AI set up and text recognition enabled, the content is transcribed during analysis.

edit.title: Edit document
edit.areaHint: Determines who can see the document.
edit.areaMoveHint: Afterwards only members of “{{area}}” and administrators can see it.

delete.title: Delete document?
delete.text: “{{title}}” will be deleted. You can undo this in the history for 30 days; after that it is removed for good.

chat.intro: Ask a question about this document – the AI answers based on its content.
chat.thinking: The AI is reading the document …
chat.notConfigured: Questions about the document need an AI to be set up.

suggestions.deadlines: Are there any deadlines or dates?

versions.title: Versions
versions.intro: Every change to the PDF creates a new version. Older versions are kept and can be viewed, downloaded or restored.
versions.restoreText: This version becomes the current one. The current version is kept, and the step can be undone in the history.

retention.label: Retention
retention.until: until {{date}} – cannot be deleted before then
retention.locked: Must be retained until {{date}} – can only be deleted afterwards

document.readOnly: In this area you may only view this document.

mailboxes.title: Mailboxes
mailboxes.navHint: IMAP servers from which PDF and photo attachments are imported
mailboxes.intro: PDF attachments, attached photos (as PDFs) and e-invoices (XRechnung as XML) are imported automatically from these IMAP mailboxes; the text of the e-mails and embedded logos are not. The mailboxes are only read – e-mails stay unchanged and unread.
mailboxes.emptyText: Enter the credentials of an IMAP mailbox – for example the mailbox your scanner sends documents to.
mailboxes.firstSyncRunning: The first check is already running.

delete.title: Remove mailbox?
delete.text: “{{name}}” will no longer be checked. Documents that have already been imported are kept.

dialog.description: You get the credentials from your email provider. The password is stored encrypted.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.securityNoneWarning: Without encryption, the username and password are transmitted in plain text.
dialog.passwordKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the stored password
dialog.enabledHint: The mailbox is checked for new attachments at the configured interval.

filter.title: Filter
filter.intro: Only e-mails that meet all conditions are evaluated. One term per line; upper and lower case do not matter, part of the text is enough. Empty fields do not restrict anything.
filter.subjectIncludes: Subject contains one of these terms
filter.subjectExcludes: Subject contains none of these terms
filter.senderIncludes: Sender contains one of these terms
filter.senderExcludes: Sender contains none of these terms
filter.newOnly: The filter applies to e-mails that arrive after the last check; e-mails already checked are not evaluated again.

dialog.intervalHint: Leave empty to use the general interval (currently {{interval}}).
dialog.areaHint: Imported documents go into this area.

import.title: Schedule & import folder
import.intro: Defines how often the application looks for new documents – in the mailboxes and in the import folder.

interval.title: Check interval
interval.text: How often the application checks the import folder and all mailboxes without their own interval for new documents.
interval.label: Every … minutes

folder.title: Import folder
folder.text: A directory on the server that is watched for new PDFs, photos (JPG, PNG, HEIC) and e-invoices (XML) – for example the target of a network scanner. Subfolders are searched as well.
folder.pathHint: Absolute path. In the Docker container this is the mounted folder, usually {{path}}.
folder.keepHint: The files stay unchanged. The application remembers what it has already imported.
folder.moveHint: Imported files are moved to the “{{folder}}” subfolder – the import folder stays tidy.
folder.scanStarted: The import folder is being checked.
folder.areaHint: Documents from the folder go into this area.

ai.title: AI
ai.navHint: LLM server, model and text recognition
ai.intro: The AI reads every new PDF, summarizes it, assigns a document type and tags, and extracts key facts such as amounts or deadlines.

server.title: LLM server
server.compatibilityModeHint: For servers that speak the Anthropic interface but support neither PDF input nor structured outputs: the document is sent to the model as text or, for scans, as page images. Leave this off for the Claude API.
server.testIncomplete: The settings are not complete yet

privacy.title: With {{provider}}, your documents leave this computer
privacy.text: For analysis, the content of every PDF is transmitted to the servers of {{provider}} on the internet and processed there – including invoices, contracts, medical letters and official correspondence.
privacy.recommendation: <emphasis>Recommendation:</emphasis> use a local AI. With <lmStudio>LM Studio</lmStudio> or an <compatible>OpenAI-compatible server</compatible> on your own network, all content stays with you.

ANTHROPIC.urlHint: Anthropic's Claude API. Only change this if you have your own gateway in front of it.
ANTHROPIC.modelHint: Claude Opus 5.5 is the recommended choice; Sonnet and Haiku are faster and cheaper.

OPENAI.urlHint: OpenAI's API. Only change this if you have your own gateway in front of it.
OPENAI.modelHint: The model ID as OpenAI names it. After you save the key, the available models appear here.

MOONSHOT.urlHint: The API of Moonshot AI (Kimi). For accounts on the Chinese platform: {{url}}
MOONSHOT.modelHint: The model ID as Moonshot names it. After you save the key, the available models appear here.

LM_STUDIO.urlHint: LM Studio's local server (start it in LM Studio under “Developer”). If AIDocuments runs in Docker: {{url}}
LM_STUDIO.modelHint: The ID of the model loaded in LM Studio. Scans need a model with image input, analysis needs one with tool use.

OPENAI_COMPATIBLE.urlHint: Address of a server that speaks the OpenAI interface – usually ending in /v1, e.g. {{url}}
OPENAI_COMPATIBLE.modelHint: The model ID as the server names it. After saving, the models it offers appear here.

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.placeholderIfRequired: only if the server requires one
apiKey.hintRemoving: The stored key will be removed when you save.
apiKey.hintStored: A key is stored in encrypted form. Leave empty to keep it – <remove>remove key</remove>
apiKey.hintEnvironment: The key currently comes from the server configuration (environment variable or configuration file). A key entered here takes precedence.
apiKey.hintPreset: A key for this provider is preset in the server configuration. Leave empty to use it.
apiKey.hintDiscardedOnSwitch: The key stored so far belongs to {{previous}} and will be discarded when you switch.
apiKey.hintPresetOtherProvider: The preset key is only valid for {{previous}}. Please enter a separate one for {{provider}}.
apiKey.hintRequired: Stored in encrypted form and never shown again.
apiKey.hintLocal: Local servers usually do not need a key.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.effortHint: More thorough means more careful results, but slower and more expensive per document.
analysis.outputLanguageHint: The AI writes the title, summary and tags in this language.
analysis.ocrHint: The application has the AI transcribe scanned PDFs without a text layer – only then can they be found by full-text search. Each scan takes more time and costs more.
analysis.quickOcrFirst: Quick text recognition first, then refine with the AI
analysis.quickOcrFirstHint: New scans are read by the built-in text recognition (Tesseract) first – they are searchable within seconds. The AI then adds title, summary and tags based on this text.

ai.unanalyzed_one: {{count, number}} document has not been analyzed by the AI yet.
ai.unanalyzed_other: {{count, number}} documents have not been analyzed by the AI yet.
ai.analysisStarted_one: {{count, number}} document is now being analyzed.
ai.analysisStarted_other: {{count, number}} documents are now being analyzed.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Each person signs in with their own account. Administrators manage the application, users work with the documents.

delete.title: Delete user?
delete.text: The account “{{name}}” will be deleted and signed out immediately. Documents are kept.

dialog.selfNotice: This is your own account. After saving you will have to sign in again.
dialog.passwordKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the current password. Otherwise at least 8 characters.

roleHints.ADMIN: May do everything – including changing settings, managing users and deleting documents.
roleHints.USER: May view, search and upload documents and edit their details.

dialog.activeHint: Disabled accounts cannot sign in; active sessions end immediately.

users.resetTwoFactorHint: Two-factor authentication is on for this account.
users.resetTwoFactorText: {{name}} will then sign in with the password only and can set up two-factor authentication again – for example after losing the phone with the app.

areas.title: Areas
areas.intro: Every document is in exactly one area. Users see only the documents of the areas they are a member of, plus those of areas open to everyone.
areas.adminHint: Administrators see all areas, even without being a member.

delete.label: Delete {{name}}
delete.title: Delete area?
delete.text: The area “{{name}}” will be deleted. This is only possible while no documents, mailbox or inbox folder use it.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.generalNameHint: Leave empty to call the area “General” in every language.
dialog.everyoneHint: All signed-in users see the documents in this area.
dialog.membersHint: Only members and administrators see the documents of this area. For each member, choose whether they may only read, also edit, or also delete.
dialog.noUsers: There are no users without the administrator role yet.
dialog.membersHintEveryone: Everyone sees the documents of this area. Add members here if they should be allowed more than everyone else.

retention.title: Retention
retention.intro: Set how long documents of a category must be kept – invoices for ten years, for example. The period counts from the end of the year the document is from. Until then nobody can delete it.
retention.permanent: A lock cannot be lifted – not even by administrators. If a rule is shortened or deleted, or a document's category changes, the period already set remains.
retention.emptyText: Without a rule documents can be deleted at any time.

delete.label: Delete rule for {{category}}
delete.title: Delete rule?
delete.text: New documents of the category “{{category}}” will no longer get a period. Documents already locked stay locked until their period ends.

dialog.categoryHint: As shown on the document; upper and lower case do not matter.
dialog.yearsHint: Counted from the end of the year of the document date (without a date: of the day it was added).
dialog.shorterHint: A shorter period only applies to documents without a period yet. Documents already locked stay locked until the end of their current period.

mailOut.title: Sending e-mail
mailOut.intro: The application sends reminders for due follow-ups through this SMTP server – once per follow-up, collected in one e-mail per person. The recipient is whoever takes care of the follow-up and has entered an address in the user menu.
mailOut.enabledHint: When switched off, follow-ups only appear in the application.
mailOut.usernameHint: Leave empty if the server does not require a login.
mailOut.passwordKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the saved password.
mailOut.fromHint: Your server must allow it for your account.
mailOut.appUrlHint: For links in the e-mails, e.g. https://docs.example.com. Empty = no links.
mailOut.testNeedsAddress: For the test message, enter your own e-mail address in the user menu.
mailOut.testSavedHint: The test uses the saved settings – please save first.

backup.title: Backup & import
backup.navHint: Back up everything at once, take over exports
backup.intro: A backup contains everything needed to restore AIDocuments exactly as it is. An import takes over documents from the export of another installation – with their details.
backup.backupText: A ZIP with the database, all documents including earlier versions, the thumbnails and the key for stored passwords. The app keeps running meanwhile.
backup.keyWarning: The backup is not encrypted and contains the key to the stored passwords (mailboxes, AI, two-factor sign-in). Keep it as safe as the documents themselves.
backup.restore: To restore: stop AIDocuments, extract the contents of the ZIP into an empty data directory and start it again. Instructions are included in the ZIP (README.txt).

encryption.label: Encryption
encryption.configured: With the backup password from the .env file
encryption.own: With a password of your own
encryption.passwordHint: At least {{min}} characters. It is not stored anywhere – without it, the backup can no longer be opened.
encryption.configuredNote: The ZIP is encrypted with AES-256 and the password from AIDOCS_BACKUP_PASSWORD. Keep a copy of it outside the server as well, for example in a password manager – if the server fails, you need it to restore.
encryption.ownNote: The ZIP is encrypted with AES-256. Keep the password safe, for example in a password manager.
encryption.openWith: It can be opened with 7-Zip (Windows, Linux), Keka or The Unarchiver (macOS) – not with the built-in extraction of Windows or macOS.

backup.externalDatabase: One-click backups are only available with the built-in database. With MariaDB, back up the database with its own tools (such as mariadb-dump) and the data directory as well.
backup.importText: A ZIP from “Export” in the document list – also from another installation. Title, category, tags and other details are kept; the AI does not read the documents again. Files that already exist are skipped.
backup.areaHint: The documents go here – or only those whose area does not exist here.
backup.matchAreas: Put into areas with the same name
backup.matchAreasHint: If an area here has the same name as in the export, the documents go there.
backup.result: Imported: {{imported, number}} · already there: {{duplicates, number}} · not imported: {{failed, number}}

auto.title: Automatic backup
auto.text: Once a day AIDocuments writes a complete backup as a ZIP to a folder and keeps the most recent ones. Ideally the folder is on another disk or a network drive – if the disk with the data fails, the backups would otherwise be lost too.
auto.keepHint: Number of backups; older ones are deleted.
auto.directoryHint: Full path on the server. Leave empty for the default. In the Docker container the folder must be mounted.
auto.warnAfterDaysHint: Notice in the document list when there has been no backup for this long – manual or automatic. 0 = never warn.
auto.runStarted: The backup is running in the background.
auto.externalDatabase: Automatic backup is only available with the built-in database. With MariaDB, back up the database with its own tools (for example a nightly mariadb-dump) together with the data directory.
auto.encrypted: The backups are encrypted with AES-256 and the backup password from the .env file (AIDOCS_BACKUP_PASSWORD).
auto.notEncrypted: The backups are not encrypted. To encrypt them, set AIDOCS_BACKUP_PASSWORD in the .env file and restart AIDocuments.

license.title: License
license.navHint: Type of use and unlock code

history.title: History
history.subtitle: What happened to your documents – newest entries first.

duplicates.title: Possible duplicate
duplicates.subtitle: The two documents match in content. Keep one and delete the other – or note that they are not duplicates.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.intro: Protect your account with a second factor: when signing in, you then also enter a code from an authenticator app on your phone (e.g. Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, Aegis).
twoFactor.scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app or enter the key manually. Then enter the code shown by the app, together with your password.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
twoFactor.recoveryText: Keep these recovery codes in a safe place. Each one works once if you cannot use the app – for example if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.
twoFactor.disableHint: To switch it off, enter a current code from the app (or a recovery code) and your password.
twoFactor.adminCannotDisable: As an administrator, you cannot switch off two-factor authentication.

confirmCode.title: Confirm change
confirmCode.text: Changes to accounts, mailboxes and settings need a current code from your authenticator app. The confirmation is valid for 10 minutes.

share.title: Share document
share.intro: Creates a link that lets a person without an account open exactly this document.
share.recipientHint: The person's name – so you can see later who you gave the link to.
share.permission: May this person edit the document?
share.viewHint: The person can view, print and download the PDF.
share.editHint: The person can also mark up, write in, sign and save the PDF. Every save becomes a new version; title, tags and other details stay hidden.
share.linkHint: Anyone who has this link can open the document – only pass it on to {{name}}. You can revoke it at any time in the document view.
share.revokeText: The link stops working immediately. Copies the person has already downloaded stay with them.

page.invalid: This link is invalid or has expired, or the document was deleted. Please contact the person who gave it to you.

reminders.title: Follow-ups
reminders.assigneeHint: This person sees the follow-up under “Mine” and gets the reminder by e-mail. Everyone who can see the document can be chosen.

delete.label: Delete follow-up
delete.title: Delete follow-up?
delete.text: The follow-up will be removed. The document stays unchanged.

reminders.suggestionsHint: The AI found dates in this document:
reminders.suggestionsPageHint: Deadlines in the next six months that the AI found in the documents. Add them as a follow-up or dismiss them.
reminders.emptyText: Add a follow-up to a document – or take one the AI suggests.

repeat.label: Repeat
repeat.hint: When you tick off the reminder, the next one is created at the same interval.

pages.title: Edit pages
pages.intro: Drag pages or move them with the arrows, rotate or remove them. Saving creates a new version – the previous one is kept.
pages.noneLeft: At least one page must remain.

split.title: Split document?
split.text: Page {{page}} and all following pages become a separate document in the same area. It is read and filed like a newly received one; this document keeps the pages before.

merge.title: Append documents
merge.intro: The pages of the chosen documents are added in this order to the end of “{{title}}”.
merge.noDeleteRight: You may not delete it – so you cannot append it.
merge.hint: The appended documents then go to the trash; they can be restored from the history for 30 days.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.pageIntro: Terms and notice periods of all contracts you may see – those needing action soon first.
contracts.emptyText: Open a document, such as an electricity or phone contract, and record its term and notice period there. A reminder then appears in good time before the deadline.
contracts.none: Is this a contract? With its term and notice period, AIDocuments reminds you in good time to cancel.
contracts.intro: The end of the term and the notice period give the date by which notice must be given. A reminder appears before it; if the term ends without notice, it renews automatically.

remove.label: Remove contract details
remove.title: Remove contract details?
remove.text: The term, notice period and the open reminder for it are removed. The document itself stays.

contracts.endDateHint: End of the current term; empty = open-ended
contracts.noticeHint: Months before the end of the term; empty = until the end of the term
contracts.renewalHint: Without notice, the contract renews by this many months; 0 = it ends
contracts.cancelledHint: It then no longer renews, and no more reminders appear.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.intro: With a passkey you sign in without a password – unlocked with your fingerprint, face or device PIN. It only works for this address; a fake site cannot use it.
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.nameHint: So you can recognize it later, e.g. “Laptop” or “Password manager”.
passkeys.passwordHint: Whoever adds a passkey can sign in without a password from then on – so please confirm once.
passkeys.unsupported: This browser cannot use passkeys here. Passkeys only work over HTTPS (or localhost).
passkeys.unsupportedIp: Passkeys only work over HTTPS and with a name in the address, not with an IP address.

remove.label: Remove passkey
remove.title: Remove passkey?
remove.text: Nobody can sign in with “{{name}}” afterwards. It stays stored in the password manager or on the device until you delete it there.

einvoice.title: E-invoice
einvoice.exact: Read exactly from the XML file, without AI · {{format}}

license.question: Who uses AIDocuments?
license.freeFor: Free for private individuals, clubs and public authorities.
license.businessNeedsCode: Businesses unlock AIDocuments with an unlock code.
license.intro: Tell us who uses AIDocuments. Businesses enter their unlock code here – it names the company it was issued to.
license.codeHint: Starts with AIDOCS-. You can also enter it later under Settings → License; until then everything stays usable.
license.codeLaterHint: Starts with AIDOCS-. Without a code everything stays usable; only a notice is shown.
license.codeKeepHint: A code is stored. Leave this empty to keep it, or enter a new one.
license.request: No code yet? Write to <mail>{{email}}</mail> – with the company name as it should appear in the code.
license.expired: The unlock code for {{name}} expired on {{date}}.
license.storedInvalid: The stored unlock code is not valid. Please enter it again.
license.missing: AIDocuments is used by a business here but is not unlocked yet. Please enter an unlock code.
license.missingUser: This installation is not yet unlocked for business use. Please contact your administrator.
license.unset: Please tell us who uses AIDocuments – it is free for private individuals, clubs and public authorities.
